key_insight: An LLM-based tool was built to turn oncology scan reports into patient-friendly plain-language summaries that can be shared through patient portals.
clinical_relevance: If effective, this could improve patient understanding of imaging results while fitting into oncology workflows without replacing clinician review.
method: Modified three-wave staircase rollout across randomized oncology disease groups
~60 providers from 11 disease focus groups, with surveys before and after implementation
Patient surveys plus interviews with patients and oncologists to assess communication, workload, and implementation
evidence_signal: This is a protocol rather than outcomes paper, so the abstract reports planned mixed-methods evaluation but no efficacy results yet.
watch_item: AI-generated summaries may reduce confusion, but they still need careful oversight to avoid inaccuracies, over-simplification, or added clinician review burden.
paper_title: Implementing AI-assisted, patient-friendly imaging report summaries to enhance oncology care delivery: protocol for a randomized mixed-methods quality improvement study
